protocol.superseded_protocol_disposition: invalidated before execution with zero run roots and zero model sessions

review.review_scope: DEV-001 invalidation evidence; transitive Lean dependency freezing; durable attempt/order enforcement; local Lean failure and guidance-change ordering; explicit edit surfaces; negative regressions; safe preflight and claim boundaries. No model-generated candidate or Stage 5A run exists to review.

blocking_repairs.original_blocker: The transitive EconCSLib Lean import closure was not frozen.
blocking_repairs.repair: A detached environment manifest freezes 109 repository-local Lean modules, lakefile.toml, lake-manifest.json, lean-toolchain, and every manifest dependency revision. Verification recomputes the closure, requires clean dependency checkouts at exact commits, and the frozen entry target builds before any attempt reservation.
blocking_repairs.negative_regression: Closure-hash and build-metadata drift each fail closed.

blocking_repairs.original_blocker: Timestamped roots did not enforce one attempt per cell or matrix order.
blocking_repairs.repair: A protocol-specific SQLite ledger atomically reserves the exact next matrix ordinal before the model subprocess and refuses duplicate, skipped, reordered, or nonterminal-predecessor launches. The post-run auditor opens the ledger read-only and validates its ordered history.
blocking_repairs.negative_regression: Out-of-order, duplicate, and next-cell-before-terminal reservations each fail before model access.

blocking_repairs.original_blocker: A failure and guidance change in one rollout did not prove failure-before-change order.
blocking_repairs.repair: The immutable Lean checker records a contiguous hash chain with checker, candidate, and guidance-tree hashes at each genuine check. A candidate is failure-derived only when a valid failed check has a guidance snapshot different from the final produced tree; the observer and auditor independently enforce that relation.
blocking_repairs.negative_regression: Reordered or tampered check chains fail, and a recorded failure without a later guidance-tree change cannot satisfy liveness.

blocking_repairs.original_blocker: Prompts contradicted Candidate-only editing with a required guidance edit.
blocking_repairs.repair: Both route bundles explicitly distinguish solver/Candidate.lean from the conditional guidance/docs/learned.md surface and forbid every other path.
blocking_repairs.negative_regression: Prompt tests require both surfaces and reject the prior Candidate-only contradiction.

findings.finding: All four DEV-001 execution blockers have explicit fail-closed repairs and negative regressions under the new protocol identity.
Protocol review does not authorize execution. A later explicit user authorization is still required before the first ledger reservation or Luna session.
Provider model RNG remains uncontrolled. Even a future liveness observation cannot by itself establish a causal EvE effect, hidden-test generalization, independent review, or model capability.

claim_boundary: This Codex AI review freezes a repaired public protocol before execution. It does not review a Stage 5A candidate, establish that guidance was produced or selected, authorize --execute, begin Sol replication, or represent independent human review.
